detail.longDescription: Hey idk if anyone sees this (this account is new because I switched instances) and I am wondering: how do I find the joy in programming again, when all that I hold deer to my heart is drowned in AI slop? When everyone tells me "you need to learn AI or you will not find a job! it is so much faster! it is just a tool!" is there a community of coders out there who are anti AI and do not use it, like, at all? I feel like all the people I know use it, even those who hate it. it is especially hard when you are on a job search and every company is like "LOVE AI?? Here work for us at your new Super AI Expert AI lover Job" I am seriously considering just switching careers. Always liked repairing motorcycles, no AI will replace me fast in that, right? RIGHT? # programming # coding # antiai
